moments.title: EFL Championship Kicks Off!
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Sky Bet EFL Championship season begins tonight, Friday 14th August, with Wolverhampton Wanderers hosting Blackburn Rovers to kick off the new campaign.

angles.name: Kick-off excitement
angles.copy: It's finally here! The new EFL Championship season kicks off tonight with Wolves vs Blackburn. Who are you backing for promotion this year?

angles.name: Weekend football frenzy
angles.copy: Championship football is back! Get ready for a weekend of thrilling action as the 2026/27 season gets underway across the UK. What's your match of the day?

moments.title: Welsh Derby: Wrexham vs Cardiff
moments.blurb: The EFL Championship opening weekend continues with a major Welsh derby as Wrexham travel to face Cardiff City on Monday, August 17th.

angles.name: Local rivalry
angles.copy: It's a huge one for Welsh football fans! Wrexham head to Cardiff for a Championship clash on Monday. Who's taking the bragging rights?

angles.name: Big game build-up
angles.copy: The hype is real for Monday's Wrexham vs Cardiff game. This is more than just three points, it's about Welsh pride in the Championship!

moments.title: UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart for August 7th, 2026, saw Sam Fender and Olivia Dean holding the No. 1 spot with 'Rein Me In', while Ariana Grande had multiple new entries and climbers.

angles.name: Chart topper
angles.copy: Still at #1! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean reign supreme on the Official UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. What's your favourite track this week?

angles.name: Ariana's chart takeover
angles.copy: Ariana Grande is dominating the charts! With new entries 'petal' and 'kiss me' making big moves, it's a huge week for the pop superstar. What's your favourite new Ariana track?
